title: NETSTREIT Corp. Announces Pricing of Upsized Forward Common Stock Offering
summary: NETSTREIT Corp. (the “Company”) announced today that it has priced a public offering of 10,980,000 shares of its common stock at a public offering price of $19.00 per share in connection with the forward sale agreements described below. The Company has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1,647,000 shares of common stock. The offering is expected to close on February 13, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Wells Fargo Securities and BofA Securities are acting as book-running managers and representatives of the underwriters for the offering. Jefferies, Truist Securities, Mizuho, Capital One Securities, Scotiabank, Huntington Capital Markets, Regions Securities LLC, BTIG, RBC Capital Markets, Stifel and TD Securities are acting as joint book-running managers for the offering.
